header: Browser error when using OpenSearch Dashboards
content:
Your browser wraps service error messages in HTTP response objects when you use Dashboards to
view data in your OpenSearch Service domain. You can use developer tools commonly available in
web browsers, such as Developer Mode in Chrome, to view the underlying service errors and assist
your debugging eﬀorts.
To view service errors in Chrome
1.
From the Chrome top menu bar, choose View, Developer, Developer Tools.
2.
Choose the Network tab.
3.
In the Status column, choose any HTTP session with a status of 500.
To view service errors in Firefox
1.
From the menu, choose Tools, Web Developer, Network.
2.
Choose any HTTP session with a status of 500.
3.
Choose the Response tab to view the service response.
